```{r}
#packages
library(pacman)
p_load(Seurat,SeuratData,Matrix,dplyr,DropletUtils,presto,gprofiler2,ggplot2,patchwork,gplots,cowplot,gprofiler2,openxlsx, plyr,scDblFinder,BiocParallel,RColorBrewer)
```

#1-load the data
```{r}
####LOAD THE DATA

lec_obj = readRDS("data/process/temp/lec_subset.rds")
table(lec_obj$celltype)
```


#2-perform N,S,FVF AND RPCA

```{r}
###normalize, scale, runpca,find varfeature####

lec_obj = NormalizeData(lec_obj)
lec_obj = FindVariableFeatures(lec_obj)
lec_obj = ScaleData(lec_obj, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
lec_obj = RunPCA(lec_obj)

```

#3-PERFORM INTEGRATION

```{r}
##perform integration: no need to join layers###
library(harmony)
lec_obj =RunHarmony(
  lec_obj, 
  group.by.vars = "orig.ident",
  orig.reduction = "pca", 
  dims.use = 1:30
)
Reductions(lec_obj) # to check harmony: run succesfully

#visualization
lec_obj = RunUMAP(lec_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
p1=DimPlot(
  lec_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = c("sample"),
 label.size = 2, shuffle = T
)
p1 

```


#4-CHECK THE TRESHOLD FOR THE PCA AND THE RESOLUTION BEFORE FINDING THE CLUSTERS AFTER INTEGRATION.BASED ON DATA SIZE , WE CAN CHOSE A RANGE OF RESOLUTION


```{r}
#use ans ELBOWPLOT:shows the variance explained by each principal component (PC).You use it to decide how many PCs to keep
ElbowPlot(lec_obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca") +
  ggtitle("Elbow plot - LEC sample")

```
#4_1 PERFORM DIFFERENT RESOLUTION
```{r}

library(RColorBrewer)
#for color 
# Number of clusters
n_clusters <- length(levels(Idents(lec_obj)))

# Create enough distinct colors
if(n_clusters <= 12){
  my_colors <- brewer.pal(n_clusters, "Paired")
} else {
  # For more than 12 clusters, interpolate a larger palette
  my_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_clusters)
}

# Set identities if not already
Idents(lec_obj) <- "harmony_clusters"  # replace with your cluster column
#1 Build the nearest-neighbor graph (required before clustering)
lec_obj <- FindNeighbors(lec_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

##
#2 Create clusters at resolutions from 0.3 to 1.0
for (res in seq(0.3,1, by = 0.1)) {
  lec_obj <- FindClusters(lec_obj, resolution = res)
}

#3 Get all clustering resolution columns from metadata
res_cols <- grep("RNA_snn_res", colnames(lec_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)


#4 Plot each resolution separately
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(lec_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction =  "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
}

#5 (Optional) Combine all plots into one grid for comparison
library(patchwork)

plots <- lapply(res_cols, function(res) {
  DimPlot(lec_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
    ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
})

wrap_plots(plots)

```

#3-2 NOW CLUSTERS 
i took 0.5 because the clusters are well separated,clear boundaries. For the rest we noticed clusters that split again into sub pieces
```{r}
#### clusters after integration
lec_obj = FindNeighbors(lec_obj, reduction="harmony", dims = 1:30)
lec_obj = FindClusters(lec_obj, resolution =0.5, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters") 
```

#4-FIND ALL MAKERS

```{r}
##find all markers###########################
#first
all_markers_lec <- FindAllMarkers(
  lec_obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,     # only genes upregulated in each cluster
  min.pct = 0.25,      # minimum % of cells expressing the gene
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

#filter for significance(IMPORTANT)
all_markers_lec <- all_markers_lec %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.25)

##save it for next(important) 
library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(
  all_markers_lec,
  file = "output/temp/all_markers_lec.xlsx"
)


###########################for just 30 markers  for the annotation ###############

#1️⃣ Add gene and cluster info
all_markers_lec$feature <- all_markers_lec$gene
all_markers_lec$group <- all_markers_lec$cluster

# 2️⃣ Keep only significant markers
all_markers_lec <- all_markers_lec %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

# 3️⃣ Get cluster IDs
clusters <- unique(all_markers_lec$group)

# 4️⃣ Extract top 30 genes for each cluster
top_genes_list <- list()

for (clust in clusters) {
  top_genes <- all_markers_lec %>%
    filter(group == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    pull(feature)
  
  top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]] <- top_genes
}

# 5️⃣ Print top 30 marker genes for each cluster
for (clust in names(top_genes_list)) {
  cat("=== ", clust, " ===\n")
  print(top_genes_list[[clust]])
  cat("\n")
}
################
```

# LEST CHECK WHICH CLUSTERS ARE LEC BASEDE ON CANONICAL MARKER LEC

Clusters expressing PROX1 + PDPN (+ at least one of the other markers) → definitely LEC

LYVE1 helps you identify capillary LECs

CLDN11, GJA4, PTX3, BMP2 → collecting or valve LECs

ACKR4 → sinus / minor LEC subtypes

```{r}
lec_markers <- c("CLDN11","GJA4","MFAP4","PTX3","BMP2","ACKR4","LYVE1","PROX1","PDPN")
DotPlot(lec_obj, features = lec_markers, cols = c("lightgrey", "darkgreen")) +
  RotatedAxis() + ggtitle("Expression of Known LEC Markers Across Clusters")
```

According to the plot above, the cluster 4 have very low expression of the canonical marker so, we can remove theme

#6-THE NUMBER OF CELLS PER DONORS
```{r}
#WE extract the metadata , the columns we need: the cluster and the donor
#orig.ident= which donor each cell belong , "harmony_clusters:which cluster each cell belong 
# change the colname to donor
lec_obj$Donors = lec_obj$orig.ident
#create a meta: what we need for the plot 
meta = lec_obj@meta.data[,c("harmony_clusters","Donors")]
table(meta$Donors)
```


#6-1PLOTS THE NUMBER OF CELLS PER DONNORS
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Count cells per donor
cell_counts_per_donor <- as.data.frame(table(meta$Donors))
colnames(cell_counts_per_donor) <- c("Donor", "CellCount")

# Plot histogram (bar chart)
p=ggplot(cell_counts_per_donor, aes(x = Donor, y = CellCount, fill = Donor)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Cells per Donor in LEC",
    x = "Donor",
    y = "Number of Cells"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
p
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/Numb_LEC_cell_Donor.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 15,
  height = 12
)

```




#7THE PROPORTION OF DONORS IN EACH CLUSTERS

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Make sure dplyr functions are used explicitly
meta = lec_obj@meta.data

# Count cells per donor per cluster
donors_counts <- meta %>%
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters, Donors) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CellCount = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

# Compute percentage of each donor in each cluster
donors_counts <- donors_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = CellCount / sum(CellCount))

# Plot the proportion per cluster
p = ggplot(donors_counts, aes(x = harmony_clusters, y = proportion, fill = Donors)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(proportion * 100, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Donors per Cluster (LEC)",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Percentage of Cells"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p
  #save
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/Prop_donor_lec.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8)


```



#8-Correlation of cluster gene expression based on marker genes only. -AverageExpression (using only the marker genes for all clusters)


#8-1 the AverageExpression with markers genes(within clusters)
```{r}
#1-EXTRACT THE MARKER GENES#####
library(openxlsx)
colnames(all_markers_lec)

#select col#if we have to save it but not necessary
marker = all_markers_lec[, c("gene", "cluster", "avg_log2FC", "p_val_adj")]
#remove duplicate
marker_genes = unique(marker)

#2-GET UNIQUE MARKER GENES
marker_genes = unique(all_markers_lec$gene)

#3 filter MG
#all genes in rna assay
gene_in_lec = rownames(lec_obj[["RNA"]])

#only genes present in the object
marker_genes_filtered <- marker_genes[marker_genes %in% gene_in_lec]

length(marker_genes_filtered)  # should be > 0

#4 averageEpression per cluster
avr_exp = AverageExpression(
  lec_obj,
  features = marker_genes_filtered,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)

#3 to get the matrix 
avr_exp_matrix = avr_exp$RNA
dim(avr_exp_matrix)

#save (important for later)
saveRDS(avr_exp_matrix, file = "output/temp/avrEx_matrix_lec.RDS")
#load
#avr_exp_matrix = readRDS("output/temp/avrEx_matrix_lec.RDS")

```


#8-2 PLOT
```{r}
#plot
library(pheatmap)
p=pheatmap(
  avr_exp_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  main = "Average Expression of Marker Genes per Cluster(LEC)"
)
p
ggsave(
  filename = "output/temp/avr_lec.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
```


```{r}
new_ann = c(
  "0"="bLEC","1"="bLEC","2"="bLEC","3"="fLEC","4"="bLEC","5"="bLEC","6"="bLEC","7"="Down-valveLEC","8"="bLEC","9"="msLEC","10"="fLEC","11"="Down-valveLEC","12"="msLEC","13"="Down-valveLEC","14"="bLEC"
)

#Save the cell type labels in metadata

  x = as.character(lec_obj$harmony_clusters),#map numb as string
  from = names(new_ann),
  to = new_ann
))

 #Convert to factor and drop unused levels
lec_obj$new_ann <- factor(lec_obj$new_ann, levels = unique(new_ann))
table(lec_obj$new_ann)

  lec_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "new_ann",   # legend will show cell type names

)
```
